acceptance_checks.detail: Official VRS Global-ID URL and VRS feed publisher are recorded
ZIP SHA-256, byte size, file list, and feed_info are present
Actual stop IDs and stop_times references use the direct prefix rule
Parent/child relationships and unknown stop references are explicit
Only validated Cologne stop IDs count as Cologne scheduled stop events
Segments require two adjacent ordered stop events with both endpoints in Cologne
Formal and mutually exclusive trip populations are both reported
Route identity is measured separately from stop-event and segment scope
Every observed route_type has source rows and the classifier has explicit precedence
Observed rows/examples and explicit zero/absent rail categories are retained
Differing duplicate route IDs use an explicit ambiguity bucket
This tool inspects scheduled static GTFS only and makes no operational claim

precedence: 1. Resolve source route/trip identity ambiguity first; conflicting duplicate route_id/trip_id inheritance remains explicit and unclassified.
2. route_type=0 is Stadtbahn / Tram under this feed profile; no unexpected extended value is forced into tram.
3. route_type=2 establishes rail; within rail, Long-distance is checked first, then S-Bahn, RE, RB, and Other Rail.
4. route_type=3 establishes bus; SEV evidence is checked first, then validated KVB agency gives Urban / KVB Bus, otherwise Regional / Other Bus.
5. Unsupported route_type values remain OTHER_MODE; missing/ambiguous/unresolved inheritance remains explicit UNCLASSIFIED status.

scope_contract.internal_segment_definition: adjacent stop_times events of one trip after stop_sequence ordering, with both endpoints validated Cologne stops
scope_contract.parent_station_non_override: the actual stop_id referenced by stop_times controls event scope; parent_station does not pull a non-Cologne event into Cologne
scope_contract.route_identity_definition: source route_id and route rows are retained independently of event/segment geography
scope_contract.scheduled_stop_event_definition: stop_times row whose referenced stop_id is a validated Cologne stop
scope_contract.validated_cologne_stop_definition: stop_id has the prefix and exists in stops.txt; duplicate source rows are retained and reported

definitions.cologne_internal_trip: all known source stop events for the trip are validated Cologne stops and no unknown stop reference is present
definitions.cross_boundary_cologne_trip: the trip has at least one validated Cologne stop event and at least one known non-Cologne stop event
definitions.touch_only_cologne_trip: the trip has a validated Cologne stop event, no validated Cologne-internal segment, and no unknown stop reference; this diagnostic population overlaps formal internal/cross-boundary populations
definitions.unresolved_stop_scope_trip: the trip has a Cologne event and at least one stop_times reference to an unknown stop_id
